messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a public holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday (or is observed on a Monday when the statutory day falls on a weekend).  The table shows the date that created the long weekend, the holiday name, and the provinces/territories where the holiday was observed on that date.  (All provinces and territories are listed; if a province is omitted, the holiday was not observed there.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Provinces/Territories where the holiday created a long weekend |
|-------------|---------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Jan 2** | New Year’s Day (observed) | AB, BC, MB, NB, NL, NS, NT, NU, ON, PE, QC, SK, YT |
| **Feb 20** | Family Day | AB, BC, MB, NB, NL, NS, ON, PE, SK |
| **Mar 31** | Good Friday | All provinces & territories |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | All provinces & territories |
| **Jul 3** | Canada Day (observed) | AB, BC, MB, NB, NL, NS, NT, NU, ON, PE, SK, YT |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | All provinces & territories |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | All provinces & territories |
| **Nov 13** | Remembrance Day (observed) | AB, BC, MB, NB, NL, NS, NT, NU, ON, PE, SK, YT |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas | All provinces & territories |

### Notes & Exceptions

| Holiday | Observed Date in 2023 | Why it’s a long weekend | Provincial exceptions |
|---------|-----------------------|------------------------|-----------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) observed Jan 2 | Observed on Monday → long weekend | Quebec observes on Jan 1 (Sunday) – no long weekend |
| Family Day | Feb 20 (Monday) | Falls on Monday → long weekend | Quebec does not observe Family Day |
| Good Friday | Mar 31 (Friday) | Falls on Friday → long weekend | None |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | Falls on Monday → long weekend | None |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) observed Jul 3 | Observed on Monday → long weekend | Quebec observes on Jul 1 (Saturday) – no long weekend |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Falls on Monday → long weekend | None |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Monday) | Falls on Monday → long weekend | None |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Saturday) observed Nov 13 | Observed on Monday → long weekend | Quebec does not observe Remembrance Day |
| Christmas | Dec 25 (Monday) | Falls on Monday → long weekend | None |

### Quick Summary

- **Total long weekends in Canada (2023): 9**  
- **Provinces with the most long weekends:** Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland & Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, Saskatchewan (all 9).  
- **Provinces with fewer long weekends:** Quebec (8, missing New Year’s Day, Canada Day, Remembrance Day) and Yukon/Northwest Territories/Nunavut (8, missing Family Day).

Feel free to copy the table into your holiday‑planning app or let me know if you’d like the data in a different format (CSV, JSON, etc.).
